title: UI风格#198 - Brutalist Brutalism Dark (粗野主义暗)
description: 创建第198种UI风格：粗野主义暗色风格 - 深色粗野主义、混凝土、高对比度。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planGP.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Brutalism Dark style When color palette Then features concrete gray, black, stark white, red accent
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#3C3C3C (混凝土), #1A1A1A (黑), #FFFFFF (白), #FF0000 (红)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Brutalism Dark style When typography Then uses heavy brutal: Oswald, Anton, Impact
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Oswald (粗野), Anton (重), Impact (强调)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Brutalism Dark style When layout Then raw concrete blocks, exposed structure, massive type
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：原始混凝土块、暴露结构、大字体

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Brutalism Dark style When UI elements Then brutal animations, shake, impact effects
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：粗野动画、震动、冲击效果

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Brutalism Dark UI When functional Then includes dark chat, brutal agents, power stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：暗黑聊天、粗野代理、力量统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Brutalism Dark UI When copy Then uses brutal: 'Destroy', 'Break', 'Shatter', 'Raw'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'DESTROY. BREAK. SHATTER.'、按钮'SUBMIT'→'DESTROY'、'DEPLOY'→'SHATTER'
